Hi Emily / Logan — quick legal note.

1) NDA: we can proceed under our standard mutual NDA. If PrismVault prefers, send over your standard NDAs and we will review within 48 hours. No PO required to start sharing redacted artifacts.

2) Redaction rules: we will provide redacted screenshots for operational identifiers (internal hostnames, IPs, full user identifiers). Anything that materially affects control assertion (e.g., KMS key IDs tied to customer data) should remain unredacted or an attestation statement should be included. See attached redaction-guidelines.pdf for our suggested approach.

3) Evidence delivery: we will publish artifacts to a secured S3 staging area and will provide short-lived links (7 days). If PrismVault needs a longer window, state the retention window and we will try to accommodate.

4) Legal hold / audit: if PrismVault requires a rights-to-audit clause, flag that early — it typically needs an SOW addendum.

Kimberly Park
